baseline.reason: Commit 6e225123 replaced a per-byte put_bits loop in mpeg12enc with `ff_copy_bits(&s->pb, side_data->data, side_data->size)`. Because ff_copy_bits expects a bit count, not a byte count, it copies only side_data->size bits (9 bits for 9 bytes of CC data) instead of the required 72 bits, producing badly garbled closed-caption user data in the output bitstream. The fix (45daaf2) reverts to the original loop. Behavioral test: encode one mpeg2video frame with a known 9-byte A53 CC payload and compare
